quotations.old_english: Þú blíðmód bidde, þ-bar; hí (the saints) þé þingian tó þeódne

definitions.latin: placidissimam se mentem ad ilium habere . . . Placidam ego mentem erga vos gero

quotations.old_english: Hí cwǽdon þ-bar; hí ealle him swíðe blíðemóde wǽron . . . Hé cwæð, 'Ic eom swíðe blíðemód (blíðmód, blíðemóde, v. ll.) tó eów'
quotations.latin: respondebant omnes placidissimam se mentem ad ilium habere . . . Respondit, 'Placidam ego mentem erga vos gero,'

source_text: blíþe-mód. Add:, blíþ-mód. I. of gladsome mind :-- Þú blíðmód bidde, þ-bar; hí (the saints) þé þingian tó þeódne, Dóm. L. 36, 23. II. of kindly mind, kindly disposed :-- Hí cwǽdon þ-bar; hí ealle him swíðe blíðemóde wǽron . . . Hé cwæð, 'Ic eom swíðe blíðemód (blíðmód, blíðemóde, v. ll.) tó eów' respondebant omnes placidissimam se mentem ad ilium habere . . . Respondit, 'Placidam ego mentem erga vos gero,' Bd. 4, 24; Sch. 490, 8.
